**Product Title:**  
SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch

**Short Marketing Description:**  
Designed for active, connected lifestyles, the SmartFit Pro X1 combines a vibrant 1.9-inch AMOLED display with smart everyday convenience. Take calls on the go, track your health and workouts, and enjoy up to 7 days of battery life in a sleek, waterproof design built to keep up with your routine.

**Key Features:**  
- 1.9-inch AMOLED display for crisp, vivid viewing  
- Bluetooth calling for hands-free convenience  
- Up to 7-day battery life for less charging  
- Heart-rate monitoring and sleep tracking for wellness insights  
- Fitness activity tracking to support your goals  
- IP68 waterproof protection for everyday durability  

**Promotional Tagline:**  
Smart style. Smarter performance.
